alphabet_run.successor.description: next letter after 'a b c d'

bracket.close_innermost.description: closing bracket matching the innermost open bracket
bracket.close_innermost.causal_variable: type of the innermost open bracket

counting_words.successor.description: next number word after 'one two three'

induction.copy_successor.description: token following the earlier occurrence of the repeated final token
induction.copy_successor.causal_variable: identity of the repeated key token

letter_list.index_successor.description: next line label of an A./B. lettered list

month.successor.description: next month after a run of months

numbered_list.index_successor.description: next line label of a numbered list = last visible label + 1

numeric_run.last_plus_one.description: continuation of a bare ascending run: LAST number + 1

numeric_sequence.continuation.description: continue an arithmetic progression of four terms

numeric_sequence.countdown.description: continue a descending run of four terms

paren_list.index_successor.description: next line label of an 'N) item' list

roman_list.index_successor.description: next line label of a roman-numeral list

verbatim_repeat.copy.description: continue a verbatim repetition of one token

weekday.successor.description: next weekday after a run of weekdays
